blocks.heading: Cybersecurity that *Protects Your Business*
blocks.lead: Comprehensive security solutions to safeguard your data, systems, and reputation. From vulnerability assessments to managed security services — we keep you protected 24/7.

header.title: Security solutions *that work*
header.subtitle: Every business is a target. We build layered security to keep threats out and your data safe.

items.title: Security Audits
items.body: Comprehensive vulnerability assessments of your email, website, cloud storage, and endpoints with prioritized remediation plans.

items.title: Managed Security
items.body: Endpoint protection, firewall management, email filtering, and dark web monitoring — all managed by our security team.

items.title: Employee Training
items.body: Phishing simulations, password hygiene workshops, and security awareness programs tailored to your team's needs.

items.title: Data Backup & Recovery
items.body: Automated backups, tested recovery procedures, and business continuity plans to minimize downtime if disaster strikes.

items.title: Compliance Management
items.body: PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, and CCPA compliance support to meet industry requirements and protect customer data.

items.title: Penetration Testing
items.body: Simulated cyberattacks to identify weaknesses before real attackers do, with detailed remediation reports.

header.title: Security done *strategically*
header.subtitle: We assess, protect, and monitor — building defense in layers that adapt to evolving threats.

items.title: Risk Assessment
items.body: We evaluate your current security posture, identify vulnerabilities, and prioritize risks based on business impact.

items.title: Security Design
items.body: We design a layered security architecture tailored to your specific needs, budget, and compliance requirements.

items.title: Implementation
items.body: We deploy security controls, configure systems, and integrate tools with minimal disruption to your operations.

items.title: Monitoring & Response
items.body: Continuous monitoring, threat detection, and rapid incident response to keep your business protected 24/7.

blocks.heading: Ready to secure your *business?*
blocks.body: Book a free security assessment. We'll identify your vulnerabilities and provide a roadmap to protect your business.
